values.note: Check in at the Visitor Centre in Val Marie (9 a.m. to 5 p.m.), not at the campground; Rock Creek in the East Block is 166 km away, so book the right block.

booking.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/sk/grasslands/activ/camping/avantpays-frontcountry ('100% reservable'; 'please check-in at the Visitor Centre in Val Marie'; '166 km apart'), read 2026-11-18

note: Frontcountry campground on open prairie in the West Block of Grasslands NP, with a view over the Frenchman River valley; four oTENTiks, and the Coulee Centre next door gives shade and a place to cook. No water at the campground before mid-May or after September 30: fill tanks in advance. --Claude
summary: Keep. Parks Canada confirms 20 reservable electric sites (3 pull-through), vault toilets, drinking water, C$40 peak / C$36.75 shoulder (low changed 40 -> 36.75), 2026 season May 1 - Oct 12 (closes changed 09-07 -> 10-12, opens 05-15 -> 05-01). Pin on the loop. Amperage now unsourced.
